Himmat pehla insani gun hai.
Bade kaamon mein waqt lagta hai.
Khamoshi dheemi hai.
Himmat uthna hai.
Grit mazboot hai.
Waqt ke saath mushkil bhi possible.
Grit wo chup chup ki lagan hai jo shak ki garaj se bhi zyada tikti hai.
Pressure mein bhi grace—bravery.
Grit surrender se mana karta.
Sher khamoshi se ladta hai.
Khamoshi ek tarah ki resistance hai.
Chup rehna behtar hai, bewakoof na dikho.
Sunshine ki taraf face rakho, shadow nazar nahi aata.
Khamoshi badi taqat ka source hai.
Tumhari mehnat matter karti, add hoti jaati.
Courage ka matlab darr ka na hona nahi, balki us par jeet haasil karna hai.
Quiet logon ke minds sabse loud hote.
Jo aadmi pahad hila deta hai, woh chhote chhote pathar uthakar shuru karta hai.
Grit niyamit hai.
Tabhi bolo jab khamoshi se behtar ho.
